stream_synth — DRIVE scoop op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.stream_synth(flux: 'float', radius: 'float', width: 'float', *, v0: 'float' = 0.3, s0: 'float' = 0.02, rows: 'int' = 192, cols: 'int' = 64, pitch: 'float' = 0.0005, dt: 'float' = 0.0015, n_frames: 'int' = 16, supersample: 'int' = 4, seed: 'int | None' = 0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import scoop; scoop.stream_synth(flux: 'float', radius: 'float', width: 'float', *, v0: 'float' = 0.3, s0: 'float' = 0.02, rows: 'int' = 192, cols: 'int' = 64, pitch: 'float' = 0.0005, dt: 'float' = 0.0015, n_frames: 'int' = 16, supersample: 'int' = 4, seed: 'int | None' = 0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("stream_synth"))

Usage

Synthesizes a frame sequence of the coverage of a powder stream falling from the mouth (a thin band seen from the side).

Grains leave the outlet as a Poisson process (rate flux [grains/s]), with lateral position uniform over width width, and fall freely with initial speed v0, s = v₀ τ + ½ g τ² (fall distance s from the outlet). Image row 0 is at s = s0, one pixel is pitch. A union of discs of radius radius (coverage with supersample² sub-samples). Since positions are independent, coverage follows the Boolean model —— the synthesiser does not use that formula (an independent test subject for stream_areal_density).

Returns: frames (n_frames images), dt, pitch, s_rows (fall distance of row centres), truth (flux, crossings (actual number of grains crossing each row-centre height during [0, n_frames·dt) / time = the realised flux), v (free-fall speed at the row centres), radius_px). Raises ValueError: argument out of range.
